description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Requirements You have already used the chosen Glimpse this encounter

Traits Paradise-Touched

You use a Glimpse you have already used in this encounter without spending any Bandwidth for it. It takes its own actions as normal. This use can only be declared Static — never Signal, and never with Wideband, which declares both at once. Everything else about the Glimpse is unchanged.
